case: complete offline journey at 1440px preserves monitoring and restart identities
original_failure: Outer 120-second timeout; retained snapshot shows a paused schedule and an unresolved browser monitoring request.
cause: The driver reloaded after a polled Resume monitoring button became visible, before the pause acknowledgement cleared the IndexedDB pending request.

controlled_regression.injection: Commit the pause through route.fetch, hold its acknowledgement until polling exposes a visible but disabled Resume monitoring control, then release after 250ms.
controlled_regression.before_fix: Failed cadence-pause-and-resume: Resume monitoring click timed out after reload; saved monitoring recovery prompt replaced the control.
controlled_regression.expected_result: Wait until Resume monitoring is enabled before reloading; all original monitoring, restart, exact-export and learning assertions must pass.

timeout_policy.note: Outer limit unchanged. Individual actions are bounded so phase failures can retain their trace and result.
